headline: World Bank Targets Fivefold Increase in Minerals Financing to $19 Billion by 2030
summary: The World Bank Group aims to expand its financing for the metals and minerals sector to $19 billion by 2030. The initiative seeks to help resource-rich developing economies achieve long-term economic development.
why: The World Bank provides financial and technical assistance to developing countries, and increased capital allocation to mining can significantly alter global commodity supplies and emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Metals and Mining
impacts.why: Increased project financing is expected to boost capital availability for mining sector operations.
